outcome: Risk of perinatal blood transfusion for cesarean section
cohort: 71 patients who received a perinatal blood transfusion and 170 controls who underwent cesarean section between July 2018 and September 2019 (training set), and 148 patients with the same protocol from October 2019 to May 2020 (validation set)
finding: Preeclampsia, abnormal placentation, maternal age, predelivery hemoglobin, and predelivery fibrinogen were identified as risk factors for perinatal blood transfusions for cesarean sections.
